notes: Shop: stonewhistle.myshopify.com, prices in EUR (shop currency EUR). Made to order, wait about 3-5 months. Clay, fragile; clean with dry soft cloth only. Maker offers no breath-free instruments. FAQ says nothing on disability suitability: ask info@stonewhistle.com first.

items.name: Natey A4 (pocket flute)
items.why_en: A small, light clay flute that plays a gentle minor pentatonic-style scale where no note sounds wrong, easy to hold with one hand and sounded with a soft breath.

items.name: Natey E4
items.why_en: Same simple and forgiving Natey design in a slightly deeper voice, no experience needed, with a protective travel case.

items.name: ZEN flute Medium
items.why_en: Pentatonic scale of five notes plus the octave, any combination of holes sounds harmonious, played with one slow soft sigh, so almost no technique is needed.

items.name: ZEN flute Large
items.why_en: The same ZEN flute in the larger size, lower pitch and more room for bigger or less precise hands.

items.name: Innato Mini C5
items.why_en: A small three-chamber flute where every finger combination gives a pleasant three-note chord, so it cannot be played wrong, and it is light (100 g).

items.name: Innato E4
items.why_en: The full-size three-chamber chord flute, intuitive for anyone, both hands hold it, every combination of fingers sounds beautiful.

items.name: Double Flute (via reseller OneTone, not in Stonewhistle's own shop feed)
items.why_en: Two linked pentatonic chambers give a warm stereo sound, one side for melody and one for drone; price is from the reseller's from-price and may vary by key.
